(1) We introduce the concept of intra-session fairness in replicated multicast services; (2) We propose a max-min intra-session optimal solution to achieve intra-session fairness among receivers in a multicast session; (3) The max-min intra-session solution outperforms the maximal social welfare solution in terms of the fairness achieved.

intra-session fairness should be considered in addition to inter-session fairness when allocating resources to multicast receivers.
